videos.title: Videos
videos.description: YouTube video URLs (watch, youtu.be, shorts) or 11-character video IDs.

apiKey.title: GetYouTubeTranscript API key
apiKey.description: Required. Your API key from https://getyoutubetranscript.com/developers (free tier, no card). Each successful transcript uses 1 credit; failed requests are not charged.

language.title: Language
language.description: Transcript language code, for example en, es, de. Defaults to English.

timestamps.title: Include timestamps
timestamps.description: Add per-line segments with start and duration in seconds.
